title: 🧪 Add tests for electromagnetism_lab.py and fix mutable default
body:
- 🎯 **What:** The electromagnetism_lab lacked unit tests. Furthermore, ElectromagneticField and ElectricPotential used an illegal mutable default empty np.ndarray directly in the dataclasses, causing the import/initialization to crash.
- 📊 **Coverage:** Implemented 14 tests checking default values, forces calculation, boundary calculations and errors, achieving 92% coverage for the file.
- ✨ **Result:** Increased codebase reliability by catching a runtime error at import and ensuring the pure math logic is properly guarded against regressions.
